monsterDescriptions.text: Though they are not difficult to kill, take care.  Their bite is most poisonous.
Leader of King Chelton's guard.  A leader of men and true to his word.
Millions of legs whipping.  Two venemous tentacles slashing forth.  Eeesh.
Kings guard.  An uncommon fighter of considerable skill and dedication.
A mindless larva.  Nobody knows what this thing will turn into for no one has ever found one in a cocoon state.
Capable of launching a multitude of attacks, this critter is extremely deadly.
Strongest of the good dragons.  This race of dragon kind devotes their entire lives to the destruction of their evil kin.
A gaping maw of immense size makes this mindless foe one to best be avoided.
Sickly in appearance, these foul creatures blend in the very surrounding and pounce on the unsuspecting.
A common woman from the community.
Created from non-living parts and given life through arcane magic.  They will serve their creator until destroyed.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.   These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.   These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
A larger version of the ordinary troll.  The physical strength of these beasts is near god-like.
A huge man sworn to protect his community.  He will protect them to the death.
Often used to guard magical treasure or some important location.
A small child more helpless then helpful.
A mountainous man-fish.
Though they do not look fierce, they are more deadly than one might think.
Large and deadly.  Their saliva containes a strange chemical that causes those that do not save to become deathly afraid.
Common, big, ugly, mean and cruel.  A thug is a thug.
A strange cross between a Hyena and a tiger.  Nobody knows if it was spawned from magic or nature.
A very deadly, cunning undead opponent.  Her bite will drain experience!
Do not get too close.  If it get's you in a bear hug you are doomed for sure.
This subservant of Griloch has a strange evil aura which makes it invincible to some weapons.
Serves Griloch with his solsux companions.
Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  Their bite has been known to cause paralysis.
A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.
Guardian of an ancient crypt, the shadow mummy will sap your strength.
A powerful cousin to the modern day mountain lion.
Younger and weaker than their older counterparts, these evil creatures still pack a mean bite.
Few are those that have met with one, AND LIVED!
Capable of breathing lightning.  Woe are the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one of this ilk.
One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be feared.
Slave of Griloch.  Many men are persuaded by forked tongues and twisted arms.
Captain of Grilochs minions.  Commander of men.  His job iss not pretty, but he is an effective leader.
Second only to the general.  A worthy tactician.
General of the Griloch army.  Not many ascend to such a lofty post and live very long.
Grilochs most prized fighter.  His champion.  Many non-believers fall before this viper.
Weaver of darkness as a minion of Griloch.  His evil magic is glory to his followers.
Large and heavily armored with a bony back plate and horns.  Only a fool would back one of these things into a corner.
Large and brutish.  These simple minded humanoids survive by sheer brute strength.
A hardy warrior trained for combat.  A true asset to the king.
A true leader of men.  Trusted with the task of keeping the troops in line and loyal to the king.
Holly is master of the throwing daggers.  She will use them wherever possible.
Master of the staff and dabbler in the black arts, Styx is a powerful ally.
Standing 8 feet tall or more these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.  They are often employed as troops in mercenary armies.
Evil and cunning are the keys to this bad boys survival.
Old and weak but more than a match for any full grown human or orc.
Extremely strong and aggressive, these beasts make excellent warriors.
A slob of a man.  Overweight and slow, his only redeeming quality is he seems like he has a nice personality.
Father accused of stealing the icon of Achran.
The creature's favorite form of attack is to lower its armored head and charge.  Don't stand in front of it when it does.
Another one of Griloch's many guards.  This spider has been infused with arcane powers.
Subordinate of Griloch.  Bent on spreading his word no matter what. His mission:  Spread the word and convert the masses at any cost.
These minor devils live their lives as servants to those more powerful than themselves.
This beast has lost his master and will do anything to find him.
A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your very life force.
Outcasts even among thier own ilk, these poor retches have mutated even more than thier close cousins.  Unfortunatly, they are even MORE deadly.
Capable of causing disease with a simple touch of the filth on thier claws.
The race of giants can also bexome undead, as this creature will attest.  Slow and mindless, this zombie can still pack a punch.
A common thug ruled by greed.
Transformed into a minion of evil, this english fatboy needs to die.
A creature of the undead.  The touch of these foul creatures is capable of causing disease.
A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.
More mean than slimy, these snakes spit caustic acid.  When they do not spit, they lash with their tails and bite with venomous fangs.
A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.
Summoned from the planes of Hades, this servant of Griloch fights with arcane abilities.
A small reptilian race.  They are extremely evil and travel in large groups.
A giant boar.  Not much else to tell.
Champion of the secret village, he may join your quest to destroy Griloch.
King of the Cheltin Lands.
Multi armed beast of Griloch.  Evil to the core.
A friend from long ago.
A friend from long ago.
A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
Slightly larger and more powerful than goblins, these close cousins to real goblins band together in large tribes.
Truly evil beings lurk in the shadows where their evil can go unseen, but not unfelt.
Unholy God of Evil.
A brave but somewhat unskilled troop.
A conscript with little to look forward to in the civilian world.  For this reason they often re-enlist to become Corporals.
Charged to keep the troops in line.
A true leader of men.
Skilled in the ways of combat and leadership.  An up and comming officer to be sure.
Thes million legged creature can attack with multple legs in multiple directions.   A serious threat.
Beauty in Flight.  Death in battle.  The deadly gaze of the Nirak has brought an end to many a warrior.
Normaly they feed on only the dead, but in times of hunger they will hunt their prey.
Abused as a youngster.  These ill tempered men are but common thugs for hire.
Pickpocket, cutpurse, burglar.  By any name, a thief is a thief.
Minding his own business, he protects his valuables.
Keeper of Darken Castle.  A truly evil demon.
The Crauyrm bears two tentacles atop its head.  A most feared beast of water it can survive for considerable amounts of time on land.
Avoid the paralyzing bite of these large insects.
Half man, half fish, all bad temper.
A friend from long ago.
A small, but deadly version of your every day troll.
Rina, loyal wife and mother.
Huge dwarven fighter given to the party as a show of goodwill in the fight against Griloch.
A beetle that is on the large side, often reaching 6 feet in length.
Capable of casting clerical spells makes this humanoid something to fear.
Prefer to feed on the dead.  However, they will not hesitate to add a little fresh meat when only that is available.
Belonging to the arachnid family, these large critters pack a paralyzing sting.
A warrior of great skill and strength.
The priest of a tribe of orcs.
Strong and most capable with arms.
Only slightly less primitive than a cave man.  These humanoids are all but animal.

A paralyzing sting makes this large insect most deadly.
Large and fierce warriors of above average skill.
A hob goblin skilled in the use of a bow.
A mighty paladin in his day, Thyrr is still a most worthy opponent.
A underground dweller that is more reptile than man.  They hate all those that dwell above.
Resembling ghouls, these vile creatures can often be found among them.  They are much more powerful than ghouls.

Skilled in the ways of thievery as well as war, these vile thugs would just as soon slit your throat as look at you.
Menacing branches and sharp teeth make this creature of the forest deadly.
Used as a first line of defense, these swords are fierce indeed.
This cagey old veteran has a few tricks up his sleeve!
Great Blue Ape - Nasty and hungry.  From the cold lands, he carries a shivering bite.
